title: Camden Harbor Cruises
specs: View majestic lighthouses, seaside mansions, windjammers, and wildlife such as seals, porpoises, osprey, and bald eagles

services.name: Camden Harbor Cruises
services.desc: During this cruise we will see two lighthouses (Curtis Island & Indian Island) while learning the history of the bay. We'll haul a lobster trap and explain how it is done on the rugged Maine coast. Passengers can sit back, relax and take it all in or gear up for the true

services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Would you like to have the boat all to yourselves? You can charter the Lively Lady or Periwinkle for an hour or two, or even for a half or full day. We've accommodated wedding events, school and scout groups, family reunions, birding groups, lighthouse tours, corporate events and can even serve as your personal ferry

services.name: Wildlife tour
services.desc: On this 2-hour tour we will travel across the bay to a remote seal habitat. On our way we look for birds and marine life. blurb: Guests relax aboard a classic wooden motor vessel to see the Maine coast, lighthouses, mansions, windjammers, and wildlife like seals, porpoises, osprey, and bald eagles. Children can help haul lobster traps and discover marine life. Private charters are available year-round.
extraNote: All cruises subject to change due to private events and/or weather conditions · Cancellation policy available on FAQ page · Public Landing in Camden, Maine · Mid-May until Mid-October
